requestContext.problem: Dense evidence dashboards need a compact way to compare repeated metrics without losing label identity.
requestContext.painPoint: Ad hoc metric cards repeat arbitrary spacing and color choices, making comparison and future reuse inconsistent.

summary: Compose existing metric slabs into a compact horizontal rail while preserving each label and semantic tone.
assumptions: The rail remains domain-neutral and receives metric data through props.

alternatives.title: Responsive grid
alternatives.description: Reuse MetricCluster without a new pattern.

alternatives.title: Horizontal rail
alternatives.description: Create a bounded pattern optimized for side-by-side scanning.

decisions.decision: Use a horizontal wrapping rail of existing MetricSlab instances.
decisions.rationaleSummary: The repeated-label observation favors preserving MetricSlab as the identity-bearing unit while changing only the arrangement.

files.purpose: Compose MetricSlab instances into a compact reusable rail.
Verify label identity and composition contract.

tests.name: metric identity
tests.spec: Render three metrics and query each group by label.

tests.name: repository validation
tests.spec: Run npm run validate after materialization in isolation.

qaChecks.spec: Inspect imports and reject upward-layer dependencies.
Verify every metric exposes its supplied label programmatically.

risks.statement: Long values may overflow compact rails.

openQuestions: Should the rail wrap or scroll at extremely narrow widths?
